data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that rebuilds its child on scheduled, periodic or dynamic time events.
data.what_it_does: TimerBuilder provides factory constructors to create widgets that automatically call setState at specified times. It can rebuild on a fixed interval, on a list of DateTime schedules, or on custom time streams. The widget works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: Displaying a live clock or countdown
Limiting UI rebuild frequency for frequently changing data
Showing time‑since or time‑until an event
avoid_when: Needing sub‑millisecond precision or heavy computational work on each tick
Complex UI logic that should be handled outside of a simple timer
strengths: Null‑safe and works on all platforms
No additional setup or code generation required
weaknesses: Only handles time‑based rebuilds, no built‑in animation support
Can cause unnecessary rebuilds if overused
